compute_survival_function_normal: compute the survival function for a PyTorch Normal distribution using an optimized ndtr path
compute_survival_function_generic: compute the survival function for any PyTorch Distribution as 1 minus the CDF
test_survival_function: test the survival_function against a Normal distribution and verify it matches 1 minus CDF
review_survival_function_optimization: review the survival_function to understand the optimized Normal distribution path using ndtr
refactor_survival_function: refactor the survival_function to add support for additional distribution types with optimized paths
